Runtime health, readiness, loopback-only exposure, native exec approval policy, and hosted model usability are now proven. The missing openai-codex auth blocker was resolved through the native OpenClaw Codex OAuth onboarding flow and a native secrets reload, followed by a successful gateway-backed openai-codex/gpt-5.5 inference proof.

criteria_results.assessment: The sandbox is live and healthy, healthz and readyz pass, and ss shows only 127.0.0.1 listeners on 18789 and 18790 with no broad 0.0.0.0, [::], or wildcard listener on those ports.

The preflight confirmed the official image and native model-auth command path. Live gateway-backed inference now succeeds through openai-codex/gpt-5.5 after native Codex OAuth onboarding and openclaw secrets reload; the proof command returned ok=true and text OC_AUTH_OK.

The protected-boundary script was proven to fail closed without P4_APPROVED, and the live sandbox native approvals/exec-policy commands now show an approvals file with security=full, ask=always, askFallback=deny and no allowlist entries.

The only production mutation was the approved P4 private sandbox apply. It used the isolated state root, pinned image digest, loopback ports, and native approval policy; no public admin surface or non-sandbox production target was mutated.
